error_contract.spectral_domain: H/alpha_exact in[-1,1] for exact binary64 input coefficients; alpha_exact is an exact Fraction sum
error_contract.implemented_access_contract: The interval weight certificate encloses declared-logical exact RY/controlled-RY probabilities from stored angles and padded labels. Exact signed SELECT makes Bhat Hermitian/involutory in that logical model. Duhamel for shifted positive exponential contractions gives decoded access error<=a_exact*weight_l1. SDK nested-control/MCX realization, flat compiler/synthesis and instruments remain separate.
error_contract.phase_arithmetic: stored phases are binary64 and are treated as exact real angles by the coefficient certificate; 2phi and4phi are exact binary powers of two in this bounded domain; nested-decomposition and compiler-created angles are separate
error_contract.precompiler_source_scope: rigorous coefficient/weight/parameter bound for exact declared logical Cliffords, controlled gates and stored angles; Bell H/CX gates are exact in this model. This does not certify Qiskit nested controlled-gate/MCX definitions, flat compilation or fault-tolerant synthesis
error_contract.coherent_synthesis: not performed; require additional norm bounds for compiler transformations and fault-tolerant synthesis before physical/postselection projections
error_contract.instrument_contract: initial resets, success measurements, unconditioned reference discard/reset and final readout are outside the coherent scalar certificate
error_contract.input_representation: finite exact binary64 Pauli coefficient list; original physical-model representation error excluded
